cold_night.narration.1: Brrr! Tonight is the coldest night yet in our story.
cold_night.narration.2: Heaters use a lot of power. The plants and crew need warmth, but heating every system costs power.
cold_night.narration.3: What can we switch off? What matters most, Commander?
cold_night.dialogue.1: Plants freeze if it gets too cold. Tomorrow’s food needs them!
cold_night.dialogue.2: Maybe we turn off what we don’t need.
cold_night.question: Where does the heat go?
cold_night.A.label: Heat everything (Power −18, Life +3)
cold_night.A.after: Everyone is warm, plants and crew! Heating everything used a lot of power.
cold_night.B.label: Heat the crew and plants only, lab off (Power −10)
cold_night.B.after: We kept what matters warm and saved power by switching off the lab. Good prioritizing!
cold_night.C.label: Minimum heat (Power −5, Life −5, plants suffer)
cold_night.C.after: We saved lots of power, but the plants got too cold, and tomorrow’s food will be smaller.
cold_night.classroom: Which systems did you choose to heat?
cold_night.cargo.greenhouse_kit: Our greenhouse kit helps us use supplies carefully.
